scope: Readable page text added for 7 PDF-only official documents; 10 provider regulations (takanonim) added to the search catalog. Extraction quality smoke check only - no legal, currentness or table certification.
method: pdftotext -layout (poppler); pages separated by form feed, same format as existing library texts. Hebrew bidi control marks kept, as in existing texts.

ocr_cross_check.method: Pages rendered at 200dpi, OCR with tesseract (heb); share of OCR Hebrew words (3+ letters) also found in the extracted page text. OCR itself is imperfect, so 100% is not expected.

moh-health-surgery-report-2026.note: p1 is a graphic cover page; pages 1-2 also have a checked transcript in prepared-increments/health-sources-first-20261110/health-surgery-readable-pages-1-2.txt

limits: Text is an auxiliary reading copy. The original PDF is binding; numbers, parentheses, section numbers and tables may be garbled.
Provider regulation texts include table pages that the live library site hides (attribution of table values unverified). Check tables against the PDF.
Takanon PDFs are inside ../2026-11-08-official-pdf-corpus/takanon-sources.tar.gz, not extracted beside the text.
Form 161c (tax-161c, published on the live site) is not in this repository yet.
